answer: An operator running 239 keys therefore pays for 239 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the knoll quota and the copper admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the comet ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden.
